questions.nlq: For each product, indicate the address of the warehouse from which it was shipped.

However, the schema contains no column in Products, Addresses, or any intermediate table that records a warehouse address for a product, nor is there a table that maps products to warehouse locations. The only address information present is the customer's billing address linked via Customers -> Addresses, and the only relationship between Products and other tables is through Order_Items and Customer_Orders, which record the customer's purchase, not a shipment source. Consequently, there is no join path—no matching identifier, foreign key, or shared attribute—that can associate a specific product with a specific warehouse address. Therefore, the question is unanswerable due to a missing relationship between Products and Addresses.

FROM Products p
JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id

JOIN Customers c ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Addresses a ON c.address_id = a.address_id;

votes.sql:
WITH qty AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    p.product_type_code,
    SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS total_qty
  FROM Customers c
  JOIN Customer_Orders co ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
  JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, p.product_type_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    customer_name,
    product_type_code,
    total_qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_name ORDER BY total_qty DESC, product_type_code) AS rn
  FROM qty
)
SELECT
  customer_name,
  product_type_code AS preferred_product_type
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY customer_name;

SELECT p.product_type_code,
       a.address_details,
       SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS total_quantity
FROM Products p
JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN Customer_Orders co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
JOIN Customers c ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Addresses a ON c.address_id = a.address_id
GROUP BY p.product_type_code, a.address_details;

GROUP BY p.product_type_code
ORDER BY p.product_type_code;

JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Customer_Orders co ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
JOIN Addresses a ON a.address_id = c.address_id;

WITH
agent_influence AS (
  SELECT
    co.customer_id,
    p.product_type_code,
    SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER) * COALESCE(p.product_price, 0)) AS total_value
  FROM Customer_Orders co
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY co.customer_id, p.product_type_code
),
ranked_agents AS (
  SELECT
    ai.*, 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_type_code ORDER BY total_value DESC) AS rnk
  FROM agent_influence ai
),
agent_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT
    ra.customer_id,
    ra.product_type_code,
    ra.total_value,
    ra.rnk AS level
  FROM ranked_agents ra
  WHERE ra.rnk = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    ra.customer_id,
    ra.product_type_code,
    ra.total_value,
    h.level + 1
  FROM ranked_agents ra
  JOIN agent_hierarchy h
    ON ra.product_type_code = h.product_type_code
   AND ra.rnk = h.level + 1
)
SELECT
  c.customer_name,
  h.product_type_code,
  h.total_value,
  h.level AS hierarchy_level
FROM agent_hierarchy h
JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = h.customer_id
ORDER BY h.product_type_code, h.level;

WITH cust_prod_qty AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.customer_name,
           p.product_id,
           p.product_name,
           SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS total_qty
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, p.product_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY total_qty DESC, product_id) AS rn
    FROM cust_prod_qty
)
SELECT customer_name, product_name
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY customer_name;

votes.sql:
WITH customer_product_totals AS (
    SELECT co.customer_id,
           oi.product_id,
           SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS total_quantity
    FROM Customer_Orders AS co
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY co.customer_id, oi.product_id
), ranked_products AS (
    SELECT cpt.*, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cpt.customer_id ORDER BY cpt.total_quantity DESC) AS rn
    FROM customer_product_totals AS cpt
)
SELECT c.customer_name,
       p.product_name
FROM ranked_products AS rp
JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = rp.customer_id
JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = rp.product_id
WHERE rp.rn = 1;

votes.sql:
SELECT p.product_type_code
FROM Products p
JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Customer_Orders co ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
JOIN Addresses a ON a.address_id = c.address_id
WHERE c.customer_address <> a.address_details
GROUP BY p.product_type_code
ORDER BY SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) DESC
LIMIT 3;

votes.sql:
WITH product_address AS (
  SELECT p.product_id,
         p.product_name,
         p.product_price,
         a.address_id,
         a.address_details
  FROM Products p
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN Customer_Orders co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN Addresses a ON c.address_id = a.address_id
),
max_price_per_region AS (
  SELECT address_id,
         MAX(product_price) AS max_price
  FROM product_address
  GROUP BY address_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT pa.product_name
FROM product_address pa
JOIN max_price_per_region mp
  ON pa.address_id = mp.address_id
  AND pa.product_price = mp.max_price;

WITH ProductRegions AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        p.product_price,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(substr(
            a.address_details, 
            instr(replace(a.address_details, char(10), ' '), ','), 
            -1)
        ), ''), 'Unknown') AS delivery_region
    FROM Products p
    INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    INNER JOIN Customer_Orders co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
    INNER JOIN Customers c ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
    INNER JOIN Addresses a ON c.address_id = a.address_id
),
MaxPricePerRegion AS (
    SELECT 
        delivery_region,
        MAX(product_price) AS max_price
    FROM ProductRegions
    GROUP BY delivery_region
)
SELECT pr.product_name
FROM ProductRegions pr
INNER JOIN MaxPricePerRegion mpr 
    ON pr.delivery_region = mpr.delivery_region 
    AND pr.product_price = mpr.max_price
GROUP BY pr.product_name
ORDER BY pr.product_name

WITH product_region AS (
    SELECT p.product_id,
           p.product_name,
           p.product_price,
           a.address_details AS region
    FROM "Products" p
    JOIN "Order_Items" oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN "Customer_Orders" co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN "Customers" c ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN "Addresses" a ON c.address_id = a.address_id
),
max_price_per_region AS (
    SELECT region,
           MAX(product_price) AS max_price
    FROM product_region
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT DISTINCT pr.product_name
FROM product_region pr
JOIN max_price_per_region mpr
  ON pr.region = mpr.region
 AND pr.product_price = mpr.max_price;
